svg.aria-label: Four ways context fails: poisoning, a wrong fact is reused as true; distraction, too much history so the agent repeats past behaviour; confusion, irrelevant content pulls the answer off target; clash, two statements contradict and the model cannot tell which is current.
svg.title: Four ways context fails
svg.text: Four ways context fails — none of them raise an error
Context Poisoning
A wrong fact enters the context and is then
treated as true by every later turn.
SkillMap: one listing has the wrong city, and
the agent keeps recommending it.
Context Distraction
So much history that the model repeats what
it already did instead of reasoning afresh.
SkillMap: it re-runs a search whose results
are already in the window.
Context Confusion
Irrelevant content in the window pulls the
answer off target. Not wrong — just not this.
SkillMap: asked about Pune, answers with
Hyderabad roles still sitting in context.
Context Clash
Two parts of the context disagree, and
nothing marks which one is current.
SkillMap: "internships" on turn 2, "full-time"
on turn 6 — both look equally true.
Each one returns a confident, well-formatted answer that is simply worse than it should be.
